summary: Block the gateway on a denied license
description: FR-C1-09, FR-C7-06, SEC-05, P2, and OD-5. A cached blocked state returns one generic 403 and does not call the upstream. Expired and revoked bodies match. The specific reason is only in the admin log, with a correlation id.
scope: Blocked non-streaming request is 403 and the upstream is not called
Streaming is the same 403, and an active license still returns 200
acceptanceCriteria: States expired and revoked both return status 403, code access_denied, and the same message, and the upstream client is not called. The response body does not contain expired, revoked, or license. The admin log contains the reason and the correlation id from header X-Correlation-Id. An active cache still returns the upstream content with status 200. A stream true request while blocked is 403 and is not text/event-stream. FR-C1-09 FR-C7-06 SEC-05 P2 OD-5 T7.
constraints: Do not forward a blocked request to the upstream.
Do not put the license reason in the response body.
Do not change the active-license success path into a denial.
